core_obligations: By the carded pseudo-coherence lemma E is quasi-coherent; lift to E' on X by the lifting input, and to a complex M-bullet of A-modules by the affine comparison.
Cover U by D(f_1), ..., D(f_r); the localizations M-bullet_{f_j} are pseudo-coherent by the carded affine lemma.

Induction on n: maintain a map F-bullet -> M-bullet from a bounded above complex of finite free A-modules, F^i = 0 for i < n, with H^i(alpha_{f_j}) iso for i > n and surjective for i = n; such alpha exists for n >> 0.
Induction step: the cone C-bullet has H^i(C_{f_j}) = 0 for i >= n; it is (n-1)-pseudo-coherent with finite H^{n-1} by the two algebra lemmas.

Choose finite free F^{n-1} and beta: F^{n-1} -> C^{n-1} killing the composition to C^n and surjecting onto H^{n-1}(C_{f_j}) after localization; the source waves the construction ('clear denominators') - carry it as an explicit obligation.
The displayed diagram of triangles shows the extended map is iso in degrees >= n and surjective in degree n-1; induction closes, and the tilde of F-bullet restricts to E on U.
proof_roadmap: Lifting chain to modules; induction setup; cone pseudo-coherence; finite-free extension step; triangle bookkeeping; conclusion.
difficulty_reason: An n-step induction whose engine is a cone pseudo-coherence computation and a simultaneous extension-and-surjection choice at every localization; the constructive content is genuine.
